jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Underwater Security)
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Underwater Security) to drive our go-to-market strategy, accelerate growth, and strengthen our position in the rapidly evolving underwater security market. Optics11 is a fast-growing technology company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing solutions for some of the world’s most demanding environments. Within our Underwater Security business, we develop innovative sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. jobs.why: It's a senior niche B2B growth role, but you can position your direct-response messaging and cold outreach skills to help drive their go-to-market pipeline.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager, UKI

In this role, your mission will be to accelerate the impact of our sales team with field marketing tactics alongside the Head of Regional Marketing in EMEA. Day to day activities center around high-quality execution of events with comprehensive end-to-end campaigns, identifying event trends for ClickHouse’s enterprise audience, and running campaign analysis to continuously optimize our field strategy.
